title: Residue-field fibre of a scheme module and value of a section
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $M$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $x\in X$. Its fibre is the $\kappa(x)$-module $M(x)=\kappa(x)\otimes_{\mathcal O_{X,x}}M_x$, equivalently $M_x\otimes_{\mathcal O_{X,x}}\kappa(x)$, using the stalk [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] and the residue map [def-weil-residue-field]. For an open $U\subseteq X$, a section $s\in M(U)$ and $x\in U$, its value is $s(x)=1\otimes s_x$, where $s_x$ is its germ.
